Vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free dietary preferences have category NONE unless the question involves allergies; a preference alone is not an allergy or a religious requirement. For a sensitive category, the answer may ONLY attribute or paraphrase what the source says; no yes/no, suitable/unsuitable, safe/unsafe or can/cannot suitability verdict. Never infer reception mode from availability. No outside knowledge, new URLs, timestamps, external search, or display boilerplate.
